description: One map file under data/maps/ (D-20). Named <id>.json where id == the 'id' property. Every data/maps/*.json EXCEPT active_map.json validates against THIS schema (directory rule in tools/smoke.py - the stem 'map' belongs to the balancing domain). The terrain grid paints zones; spawning is a painted zone, never point objects. Dimension consistency (row count/lengths, base/deco in bounds) is cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map, which fails loud (D-2).

base.description: The base ('hole') - the single movable map object, click-placed or dragged in the editor. Renders on the entities layer. MAY BE null: a map with no hole is allowed (the editor shows a yellow warning before Set Active), though the game needs one to be playable. The key is always present.

col.description: Base tile column, 0-based; must be < cols.

row.description: Base tile row, 0-based; must be < rows.

slot.description: Asset slot the base renders with (const-pinned; the slot registry's core/Base slot).

camera_start.description: The camera startpoint - a single movable map object, click-placed or dragged in the editor (Game tiles mode), just like the base. The game opens its camera centred on this tile; if null the camera falls back to the default corner clamp. Only DRAWN in the running game when the ui.json Debug.show_camera_startpoint toggle is on (default off); always visible in the editor. MAY BE null; the key is always present. Bounds (col < cols, row < rows) are cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map.

col.description: Camera startpoint tile column, 0-based; must be < cols.

row.description: Camera startpoint tile row, 0-based; must be < rows.

slot.description: Asset slot the marker renders with (const-pinned; the slot registry's core/Camera Start slot).

cols.description: Grid width in tiles. Each map owns its dimensions (geometry.json keeps only tile pitch and zoom levels as global truth).

deco.description: Placed deco sprites. Render on the deco layer - ALWAYS above entities (E-26), e.g. trees covering spawn tiles. Cell-snapped by the Phase 6 editor; fractional positions are legal for later phases.

col.description: World-space column position; must be < cols.

row.description: World-space row position; must be < rows.

slot.description: Deco asset slot key from the slot registry's deco category.

despawnable_spawn.description: Designer-painted SPAWN DESPAWN marks, one entry per cell. Invisible in game: never emitted by the render emitters (engine.tilemap render_items/visible_render_items/band_render_items), so nothing is drawn for a mark at any zoom. Every mark numbered n retires together on the player's nth tile purchase - the whole group of cells carrying that number flips from the SPAWNING zone to the COMBAT zone at once. An empty array means no despawn schedule is painted on this map. Bounds (col < cols, row < rows) are cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map.

col.description: Marked tile column, 0-based; must be < cols.

purchase.description: Tile-purchase count (whole tile purchases made by the player, 1-based) on which this cell stops being SPAWNING and becomes COMBAT. 1 = the very first tile purchase.

row.description: Marked tile row, 0-based; must be < rows.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the editor's Maps tree.

id.description: Stable map id; MUST equal the filename stem (data/maps/<id>.json).

additionalProperties.description: A background (non-checker) tile kind: any legend code beyond the three fixed zone codes b/c/s. Editor-extensible via the palette's '+ Level' button; the runtime collapses every such code to BACKGROUND. Never alternates (checker is const false).

legend.description: Char -> tile mapping for the terrain rows. The three ZONE codes b/c/s are const-pinned (self-describing, gameplay-meaningful); BACKGROUND codes are open (additionalProperties) so the editor can add new background types (f/l/o are the defaults new maps seed). checker: true kinds alternate to <slot>_b on cells where (col + row + 1) % 2 == 1, i.e. col+row EVEN (prototype tile.py checkerboard rule); background kinds never alternate.

rows.description: Grid height in tiles. Each map owns its dimensions.

spawnable_background.description: Designer-painted SPAWN RESERVE marks, one entry per cell. Invisible in game: never emitted by the render emitters (engine.tilemap render_items/visible_render_items/band_render_items), so nothing is drawn for a mark at any zoom. Every mark numbered n releases together on the player's nth tile purchase - the whole group of cells carrying that number flips to the SPAWNING zone at once. An empty array means no reserve is painted on this map. Bounds (col < cols, row < rows) are cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map.

col.description: Marked tile column, 0-based; must be < cols.

purchase.description: Tile-purchase count (whole tile purchases made by the player, 1-based) on which this cell becomes SPAWNING. 1 = the very first tile purchase.

row.description: Marked tile row, 0-based; must be < rows.

start_area.description: The 2x2 starting area - a single movable map object, click-placed or dragged in the editor (Game tiles mode). {col,row} is the 2x2's MIN corner (top-left anchor); it spans col..col+1 x row..row+1 and must fit inside the grid (col+1 < cols, row+1 < rows - cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map). The game anchors the 2x2 tile-unlock section grid (and the playfield window) on it; the marker never forces tile states - the designer still paints buildable tiles under it (the editor warns otherwise). Not rendered in-game; the editor draws it as a 2x2 outline. MAY BE null (the editor shows a yellow warning; the game falls back to base-anchored sections); the key is always present.

col.description: Starting area min-corner column, 0-based; must satisfy col+1 < cols.

row.description: Starting area min-corner row, 0-based; must satisfy row+1 < rows.

slot.description: Asset slot key (const-pinned; the slot registry's core/Start Area slot). The editor draws the marker as an outline, not this sprite.

terrain.description: The painted zone grid: exactly 'rows' strings of exactly 'cols' chars each (loader-enforced), terrain[row][col], chars from the legend. Row strings keep diffs one-line-per-row for git and agents (D-3 spirit).

tutorial_flute.description: The tutorial's designer-painted 'first flute' placement tile - a single movable map object, click-placed or dragged in the editor (Game tiles mode), just like camera_start. The tutorial forces the player's first economy-building placement (the flute player) onto this tile. MAY BE null; the key is always present. Bounds (col < cols, row < rows) are cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map. Never rendered by the game or the editor's normal render pipeline (the editor draws its own overlay).

col.description: Tutorial flute tile column, 0-based; must be < cols.

row.description: Tutorial flute tile row, 0-based; must be < rows.

slot.description: Marker id (const-pinned; the slot registry's core/Tutorial Flute slot). Not a real sprite - the editor draws the marker as an outline.

tutorial_stone.description: The tutorial's designer-painted 'first stone' placement tile - a single movable map object, click-placed or dragged in the editor (Game tiles mode), just like camera_start. The tutorial forces the player's first defence-building placement (the stone thrower) onto this tile. MAY BE null; the key is always present. Bounds (col < cols, row < rows) are cross-checked by engine.tilemap.load_map. Never rendered by the game or the editor's normal render pipeline (the editor draws its own overlay).

col.description: Tutorial stone tile column, 0-based; must be < cols.

row.description: Tutorial stone tile row, 0-based; must be < rows.

slot.description: Marker id (const-pinned; the slot registry's core/Tutorial Stone slot). Not a real sprite - the editor draws the marker as an outline.
